before:

packages:

    resolution: {integrity: sha512-old}
  brace-expansion@1.1.11:
    resolution: {integrity: sha512-old}
snapshots:
  minimist@1.2.7:
    dependencies:
      brace-expansion: 1.1.11

packages:
  minimist@1.2.8:
    resolution: {integrity: sha512-new}
  brace-expansion@1.1.12:
    resolution: {integrity: sha512-new}
snapshots:
  minimist@1.2.8:
    dependencies:
      brace-expansion: 1.1.12

__metadata:
  version: 4
  cacheKey: 8

"minimist@npm:^1.2.8":
  version: 1.2.8
  resolution: "minimist@npm:1.2.8"

"brace-expansion@npm:^1.1.12":
  version: 1.1.12
  resolution: "brace-expansion@npm:1.1.12"

-r base.txt
-c constraints.txt
